response_rule: Two unique in-scope final candidates offer evidence; otherwise refuse. No Gold in decision; no factual prose generation.
scope: retrieval experiment only; not production integration
remaining_r7d_work: Hash-bound formal query/cache runner and budget receipts
Run fixed 100 questions once across all three arms
Apply paired reporting and all promotion checks without post-hoc tuning
Report embedding latency separately from cached retrieval latency
limitations: Engineering acceptance is not a positive retrieval experiment result.
Answer/refuse is evidence availability, not entailment or factual answer quality.
Citation support is Gold chunk matching, not a generated-answer semantic evaluator.
Prior source and local-cache admission snapshots are retained unchanged.
